advancement.expeditive_reloaded.beautifu: Play every type of Bamboo Flute at least once
expeditive_reloaded.bamboo_flute.tooltip: Controls all wolves with a %s collar.
expeditive_reloaded.bamboo_flute.tutoria: - The pitch of the played note depends on how high you are looking.
- Look fully down to call all controlled wolves to you.
- Look fully up to make all controlled wolves sit/stand.
- Look at a controlled wolf to toggle its sitting state.
- Look at any entity to make all controlled wolves attack it.
